item.title: ACME Solar Secures SECI PPA for 190 MW Wind Solar Hybrid Project Under ISTS Framework
item.description: ACME Solar Holdings, through its subsidiary ACME Urja One Private Limited, has entered into a 25-year power purchase agreement (PPA) with the Solar Energy Corporation of India (SECI) for a 190 MW wind solar hybrid project. The agreement increases the company’s total PPA-signed capacity to 5,820 MW. The project is an Inter-State Transmission System (ISTS) connected hybrid installation, which forms part of a broader 380 MW tranche. item.title: Space-Based Solar Power Moves Closer to Commercial Reality, UK Report Suggests
item.description: A UK government-commissioned feasibility study suggests that electricity generated from space-based solar power (SBSP) systems could become economically competitive by 2040, positioning the technology as a potential complement to terrestrial renewable energy. item.title: Denmark Unveils 1 GWh Molten Salt Battery for Long-Duration Energy Storage
item.description: Denmark has unveiled a 1 GWh large-scale molten salt battery project aimed at strengthening long-duration renewable energy storage. The system, developed through a collaboration between Danish thermal energy storage firm Hyme Energy and Swiss engineering company Sulzer, is designed to supply electricity to as many as 100,000 homes for approximately 10 hours while achieving efficiency levels of up to 90 percent. item.title: OREDA Floats Tender for Rooftop Solar Projects Across Universities In Odisha
item.description: The Odisha Renewable Energy Developent Agency (OREDA) has now issued a tender inviting eligible bidders to participate in the implementation of on-grid rooftop solar projects across government universities in the state. The move is aimed at accelerating the adoption of renewable energy within Odisha’s higher education infrastructure and reducing dependence on conventional grid power. item.title: UPERC Approves Pilot Project To Facilitate Interstate Peer-To-Peer (P2P) Trading Of RE
item.description: In a significant step toward enabling cross-border renewable energy trade, the Uttar Pradesh Electricity Regulatory Commission (UPERC) has approved a six-month pilot project to facilitate interstate peer-to-peer (P2P) trading of green energy under the India Energy Stack (IES) framework. item.description: In the past year, plans announced for Khavda have turned into reality, as multiple renewable project commissionings have been announced for the region. item.title: India, South Korea Dent APAC Renewable PPAs as Global Corporate Volumes Fall: Report
item.description: Global clean power purchase agreement (PPA) volumes fell for the first time in nearly a decade last year, as power prices and policy risks reshaped market activity. item.title: Reliance Backed NexWafe in 7 GW Wafer Agreement For US Customer
item.description: Germany based solar wafer manufacturer NexWafe has entered into an agreement with Solar cell maker Talon PV for a wafer supply agreement in the US. item.title: KPI Green Energy Completes 92.4 MW Wind Project for Ayana Renewable in Bhuj with 28 WTGs
item.description: Gujarat-based KPI Green Energy has completed its 92.4 MW wind power project for Ayana Renewable Power Four at Nakhatrana, Bhuj, Gujarat. In a press release, KPI Green said the project comprises 28 wind turbine generators (WTGs). The KPI–Ayana project forms part of the broader renewable energy expansion by ONGC NTPC Green, which is actively commissioning both solar and wind capacity in Gujarat.
